L86: 河南工业大学国际学生 2026年秋季入学招生简章 Henan University of Technology International Student Enrollment Brochure for 2026
L87: 
L88:   时间：2026-03-31 10:00  来源：    浏览次
L89: 
L90: 〖学校概况〗
L91: 
L92: [School Overview]
L93: 
L94: 河南工业大学位于河南省郑州市，是一所以工学为主，涵盖工学、理学、经济学、管理学、文学、农学、医学、法学和艺术学等九大学科门类的多科性大学，是河南省人民政府与国家粮食局（现国家粮食和物资储备局）签约共建高校，中国国家教育部“中西部高校基础能力建设工程”，河南省特色骨干大学，河南省“双一流”创建高校，教育部“高校学科领域优先发展”规划高校。
L95: Henan University of Technology is located in Zhengzhou City, Henan Province. It is a multidisciplinary university mainly focused on engineering, covering nine disciplines including engineering, science, economics, management, literature, agriculture, medicine, law, and art.
L96: It is a university jointly established by the People's Government of Henan Province and the National Grain Administration (now the National Grain and Material Reserve Bureau), a "Basic Capacity Building Project for Central and Western Universities" of the Ministry of Education of China, a characteristic backbone university of Henan Province, striving to become a "Double First Class" university in Henan Province, and a planned universities under the Ministry of Education's "Priority Development of Disciplines in Higher Education Institutions" program.
L97: 学校面向全球招收国际学生，文理兼收。分为学历生与语言生教育。学历教育类别为本科、硕士研究生和博士研究生。学校为在规定年限内达到所在专业毕业要求的学历生颁发河南工业大学毕业证书；符合学校学位授予有关规定者，颁发普通高等教育学位证书。
L98: The university recruits international students from all over the world, including both arts and sciences. International student education is divided into degree programs and language programs. The types of academic education are undergraduate, master, and doctor.
L99: The university issues a graduation certificate to students who meet the graduation requirements of their major within the prescribed period of time; Those who meet the relevant regulations for degree granting in schools will be awarded a certificate of general higher education degree.
L100: 〖学期设置〗
L101: 
L102: [Semester Setting]
L103: 
L104: 每学年分为春、秋两个学期。秋季学期一般为9月至次年1月，春季学期一般为3月至7月，具体日期以大学校历为准。
L105: 
L106: Each academic year is divided into two semesters: spring and autumn. The autumn semester is generally from September to January of the following year, and the spring semester is generally from March to July. The specific dates are subject to the university calendar.
L107: 
L108: 〖项目简介〗
L109: 
L110: [Project Introduction]
L111: 
L112: 一、本科生项目
L113: 
L114: Undergraduate Program
L115: 
L116: 学制4年，最长学习年限7年。修满学分，完成培养必修环节和学位申请所有环节，授予本科毕业证书和学位证书。
L117: The education system is 4 years, with a maximum study period of 7 years. Students who complete the required credits, complete all the necessary lessons and degree application processes will be awarded a graduation certificate and a bachelor’s degree certificate.
L118: 
L119: 二、硕士研究生项目
L120: 
L121: Master Program
L122: 
L123: 学制3年，最长学习年限5年。修满学分，完成培养必修环节和学位申请所有环节，授予硕士毕业证书和学位证书。
L124: The education system is 3 years, with a maximum study period of 5 years. Students who complete the required credits, complete all the necessary lessons and degree application processes will be awarded a graduation certificate and a master’s degree certificate.
L125: 
L126: 三、博士研究生项目
L127: 
L128: Doctor Program
L129: 
L130: 学制4年，最长学习年限6年。修满学分，完成培养必修环节和学位申请所有环节，授予博士毕业证书和学位证书。
L131: The education system is 4 years, with a maximum study period of 6 years. Students who complete the required credits, complete all the necessary lessons and degree application processes will be awarded a graduation certificate and a doctor’s degree certificate.
L132: 
L133: 四、语言生项目
L134: 
L135: 一学期或一年，分为初级班与中级班。考试及格，颁发结业证书。
L136: 
L137: Language Programs
L138: The programs last for one semester or one academic year, and are divided into elementary and intermediate levels. A certificate of completion will be issued to students who pass the examinations.
L139: 
L140: 〖申请资格〗
L141: 
L142: [Eligibility for Application]
L143: 
L144: 一、本科生项目申请人须具有高中毕业学历，年龄不超过25周岁；硕士研究生项目申请人须具有学士学位，年龄不超过35周岁；博士研究生项目申请人须具有硕士学位，年龄不超过40周岁；
L145: Applicants for undergraduate program must have a high school diploma and be under the age of 25. Master's program applicants must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35; Applicants for doctoral programs must hold a master's degree and be under the age of 40;
L146: 
L147: 二、根据《中华人民共和国国籍法》不具有中国国籍且持因私有效普通护照的外国公民；
L148: Applicants should be a foreign citizen who does not hold Chinese nationality according to the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and holds a valid ordinary passport for personal reasons;
L149: 
L150: 三、申请以中文为授课语言的学科、专业时，申请人的中文能力应达到《国际汉语能力标准》四级水平（含）以上。 申请以英语为授课语言的学科、专业时，若申请人来自于英语为母语或英语为官方语言的国家，可免试英语。
L151: 
L152: 母语或官方语言不是英语的学生需提供托福成绩72分（含）以上或雅思成绩5.5分（含）以上或多邻国成绩100分以上的英语成绩证明和英文自我介绍视频。英文自我介绍视频时长2分钟，包括自我介绍、教育背景、能力展示、未来规划四个部分。语言生仅需提供英文自我介绍视频；
L153: When applying for programs and majors taught in Chinese, applicants must have a Chinese language proficiency of at least Level 4 of the International Chinese Language Proficiency Standards (inclusive).
L154: 
L155: When applying for programs and majors taught in English, applicants from countries where English is the native language or an official language are exempt from the English proficiency test.
L156: Students whose native language or official language is not English must provide proof of English proficiency with a TOEFL score of 72 or higher, or an IELTS score of 5.5 or higher, Duolingo English Test score of 100 or higher, together with a 2
L157: minute self-introduction video in English. The video shall include four parts: self-introduction, educational background, competency demonstration, and future plans.Language students are only required to submit a self-introduction video in English.
L158: 四、申请人须提交最高学历证明或预毕业证明（须经公证）、前一阶段学习成绩单、语言水平证明、来华学习或研究计划、导师推荐信、外国人体格检查表、无犯罪记录等材料。
L159: 
L160: 申请人的《外国人体格检查表》中所有健康信息均需真实无误。请注意，任何对健康情况的故意隐瞒或虚假陈述，将被视为严重的诚信问题，并可能导致申请被拒绝或已获得的录取资格被取消。
L161: 
L162: Applicants must submit the highest education certificate or pre-graduation certificate (must be notarized), transcripts of previous studies, language proficiency certificates, study or research plans in China, recommendation letters from tutors, foreigners' physical examination forms, no criminal records and other materials.
L163: The application may be invalid if the submitted materials do not meet the above requirements. All information and materials provided are factually true and correct. Otherwise all the consequences caused are undertaken by yourself (including but not limited to being disqualified from admission or expelled from academic status).
L164: 
L165: 五、建议提供六个月以内经济能力证明（以下文件中的一项: 家庭存款证明、家长/监护人收入证明，需 5000 美元/年及以上）。
L166: Financial Statement within 6 months is suggested: Either the family deposit certificate, property certificate or parent/guardian
L167: 
L168: 六、申请人应当同时符合我校相关专业学院对申请学生的学术能力及其它相关方面的入学要求；
L169: 
L170: Applicants should also meet the academic ability and other relevant admission requirements of the relevant professional colleges of our university;
L171: 
L172: 七、申请人身心健康，达到办理来华签证或居留许可的体检要求，符合报考我校专业的体检要求，能够保证在华期间正常学习、生活；
L173: Applicants should be in good physical and mental health, meets the medical examination requirements for applying for a visa or residence permit to China, meets the medical examination requirements for applying to our university's major, and can ensure normal study and life during their stay in China;
L174: 
L175: 八、无违纪、无治安处罚、无犯罪行为和记录，对华友好，品行端正，遵守中国法律和学校规章制度，尊重中国人民风俗习惯。
L176: Applicants should have no violations of discipline, public security penalties, criminal acts or records, be friendly to China, be upright, abide by Chinese laws, school rules and regulations and respect the customs of the Chinese people.
L177: 
L178: 九、根据国家政策规定，申请我校本科专业的学生，须在提交申请前参加来华留学本科入学学业审评测试。“来华留学本科入学学业审评测试成绩单”为必要申请材料。具体信息请关注官方网站（www.csca.cn)及我校国际教育学院网站（https://sie.haut.edu.cn/）。
L179: 
L180: 申请者的高中成绩单上的所有课程中，不及格门数不能超过三门，且补考通过。申请工科专业的学生，高中毕业成绩单上的数学成绩需达到及格以上。
L181: In accordance with relevant national policies, students applying for undergraduate programs at our university must take the Academic Evaluation Test for Undergraduate Admission for International Students in China before submitting their applications. The Transcript of the Academic Evaluation Test for Undergraduate Admission for International Students in China is a required application document.
L182: For detailed information, please visit the official website (www.csca.cn) and the website of the School of International Education of our university (https://sie.haut.edu.cn/).
L183: Among all courses listed on the applicant’s high school transcript, the number of failed courses shall not exceed three, and all such courses must be passed through make-up examinations. For applicants to engineering majors, their mathematics score on the high school graduation transcript must be above the passing grade.
L184: 
L185: 〖申请及入学流程〗
L186: 
L187: [Application and Admission Process]
L188: 
L189: 一、申请
L190: 
L191: Application
L192: 
L193: 各专业招生计划请见附件1。
L194: 
L195: Please refer to Attachment 1 for the enrollment plans of each major.
L196: 河南工业大学实行国际学生网上申请方式。申请人登录河南工业大学国际学生服务平台进行报名。
L197: 
L198: Henan University of Technology implements online application for international students. The applicant logs in to the International Student Online Service System of Henan University of Technology to register.
L199: 
L200: 说明事项：
L201: 
L202: Explanation:
L203: 
L204: （一）申请系统网址为：https://haut.at0086.cn/student；
L205: 
L206: The application system website is: https://haut.at0086.cn/student ；
L207: 
L208: （二）开放报名时间：2026年4月至7月，申请语言为中文或英文；
L209: 
L210: Application period: April to July 2026
L211: 
L212: Instruction languages: Chinese or English
L213: （三）申请人在线填写信息应真实、准确、完整、有效。凡因误填、漏填或填报虚假、无效信息影响录取及入学者，一切后果和责任由申请人承担；
L214: 
L215: The applicant's online information should be truthful, accurate, complete and valid. Any adverse consequences and responsibilities arising from errors, omissions, or false or invalid information that affect admission and enrollment shall be borne by the applicant;
L216: 
L217: （四）除在线填写信息外，申请人应按要求上传附件材料，附件材料为彩色扫描件，原件留存备查，cite25†申请材料列表†lb.bfsu.edu.cn 详见附件2。
L218: In addition to filling in online information, the applicant should upload the attached materials as required. The attached materials are color scanned copies, and the original copies should be kept for future reference. The list of application materials is detailed in Attachment 2.
L219: 
L220: 二、材料审查与考试考核
L221: 
L222: Material review and examination assessment
L223: 
L224: 我校将对申请材料进行审查，并视不同专业组织入学考试或考核，根据结果择优录取。
L225: 
L226: 在此期间，申请人可登录河南工业大学国际学生服务平台查询申请进度和相关通知。
L227: Our school will review the application materials and organize entrance exams or assessments for different majors, and select the best candidates based on the results.
L228: 
L229: During this period, applicants can log in to the International Student Online Service System of Henan University of Technology to check their application progress and related notifications.
L230: 
L231: 三、录取
L232: 
L233: Enrollment
L234: 
L235: 申请材料审查和考试考核均通过者，学校予以录取并发送录取通知书及相关材料，根据中华人民共和国外交部、国家移民管理局相关政策和申请学习时间长短为其办理外国留学人员来华签证申请表（JW201/202/DQ表）。申请者可到“留学中国” 网站下载电子版表格。
L236: 自录取完成到相关材料办理完毕需要2-3周。
L237: Those who have passed the review of application materials and examination assessment will be admitted by the school, and an admission notice and related materials will be sent. The school will also prepare a foreign student visa application form (JW201/202/DQ form) based on the relevant policies of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the National Immigration Administration of the People's Republic of China, as well as the length of their study period.
L238: Applicants can download the form from the website www.studyinchina.edu.cn.
L239: It takes 2-3 weeks from the completion of admission to the distribution of relevant materials.
L240: 
L241: 四、报到
L242: 
L243: Registration
L244: 
L245: 新生按照录取通知书上规定时间按时注册报到，逾期未注册报到且未说明正当理由者，按自动退学处理。
L246: 
L247: 到校报到时请携带护照、录取通知书、外国留学人员来华签证申请表（JW201/202/DQ表）、申请材料原件以备审核，不接受电子文件，未携带原件者不予注册。入境后需在指定地点重新体检。
L248: 
L249: New students shall register and report on time according to the time specified in the admission notice. Those who fail to register and report on time without providing valid reasons will be automatically expelled.
L250: When you arrive at the university, please bring your passport, admission notice, foreign student visa application form (JW201/202/DQ form), and original application materials for review. Electronic documents are not accepted, and those who do not bring the original documents will not be registered. After entering the country, you need to do physical examination again at the designated location.
L251: 
L252: 五、入学资格初审与复查
L253: 
L254: Initial review and re-check of admission qualifications
L255: 学校在学生报到时进行入学资格初审和复查。审查中如发现学生所持录取通知书、考生信息等证明材料与本人实际情况不符或存在弄虚作假、徇私舞弊等情形的，确定为不合格，将取消新生入学资格或学籍。
L256: The school conducts preliminary and second admission qualifications check for students during registration. If it is found during the review that the admission notice, candidate information, and other supporting materials held by the student do not match their actual situation or have engaged in fraud, favoritism, or other fraudulent activities, it will be determined as unqualified and their new student enrollment qualification or already obtained student status will be cancelled.
L257: 
L258: 〖奖学金申请〗
L259: [Scholarship Application]
L260: 
L261: 一、入学奖学金
L262: 
L263: 河南工业大学特设立2026年秋季国际学生入学奖学金，具体如下：
L264: 
L265: 一等入学奖学金：全额资助学费、双人间住宿费；
L266: 
L267: 二等入学奖学金：全额资助学费；
L268: 
L269: 三等入学奖学金：半额资助学费。
L270: 
L271: 2026年秋季本科生及一年制语言生收费标准按照10000元/年/生执行。
L272: 
L273: cite26†不同学历层次的学费及住宿费标准†lb.bfsu.edu.cn 详见附件3。
L274: 
L275: Freshman Scholarship
L276: 
L277: Henan University of Technology has established the 2026 Autumn International Student Freshman Scholarship, as follows:
L278: 
L279: First-class Freshman scholarship: fully funded tuition fees and double room accommodation fee;
L280: 
L281: Second-class Freshman scholarship: fully funded tuition fee;
L282: Third-class Freshman scholarship: half funded tuition fee.
L283: 
L284: The tuition fee and accommodation fee for undergraduate students and one-year language students in the Autumn of 2026 will be 10000 yuan per year per student.
L285: 
L286: The tuition and accommodation fee standards for different educational levels are detailed in Attachment 3.
L287: 
L288: 申请条件：
L289: 
L290: 1. 博士项目申请人最后学历的平均学分成绩绩点在3.5及以上，在本专业领域公开发表高水平论文至少一篇。
L291: 
L292: 项目申请人可以申请一等及以下等级的奖学金，根据专业学院的学术评审情况及汉语水平确定奖学金等级。
L293: The average credit score of the doctoral program applicant's final education should be 3.5 or above, and they should have published at least one high-level paper in their professional field.
L294: 
L295: Project applicants can apply for first-class or lower level scholarships, and the scholarship level will be determined based on the academic evaluation of the professional college and their Chinese proficiency.
L296: 
L297: 2. 硕士项目申请人最后学历的平均学分成绩绩点在3.5及以上。其中，计算机科学与技术专业申请人的本科成绩绩点在专业前5%，应用经济学专业申请人的本科专业为经济类大类。
L298: 项目申请人可以申请二等及以下等级的奖学金，根据专业学院的学术评审情况及汉语水平确定奖学金等级。
L299: 
L300: The average credit score and GPA of the final education of the master's program applicant should be 3.5 or above. Among them, the undergraduate GPA of applicants majoring in Computer Science and Technology is in the top 5% of their major, and the undergraduate major of applicants majoring in Applied Economics is in the category of economics.
L301: Project applicants can apply for second-class or lower level scholarships, and the scholarship level will be determined based on the academic evaluation of the professional college and their Chinese proficiency.
L302: 
L303: 二、晋级奖学金
L304: 
L305: 博士研究生在学业就读的第二、三、四学年，硕士研究生在学业就读的二、三学年将采取评审办法进行。具体要求按照《河南工业大学国际学生校级奖学金项目管理办法》（河工大政外〔2025〕5号）执行。
L306: 
L307: Promotion Scholarship
L308: Doctor students will undergo evaluation in their second, third, and fourth academic years, while master students will undergo evaluation in their second and third academic years. The specific requirements shall be implemented in accordance with the Management Measures for International Student Scholarship at Henan University of Technology (Henan University of Technology Zhengwai [2025] No. 5).
L309: 
L310: 三、助学金
L311: 
L312: （一）根据《河南工业大学国际学生勤工助学管理办法》（河工大政外〔2025〕8号）文件的规定，经济困难的国际学生可以申请勤工助学，以获得生活补贴。
L313: （二）鼓励优秀的国际学生参与导师的科研项目，以获得导师或学院的科研补贴，申请及执行办法由各专业学院负责。
L314: 
L315: Student Subsidy
L316: 
L317: （1）According to the Management Measures for Work-Study Programs for International Students at Henan University of Technology (Henan University of Technology Zhengwai [2025] No. 8), economically disadvantaged international students can apply for work study programs to receive living allowances.
L318: （2）Encourage outstanding international students to participate in supervisor’s research projects in order to obtain research subsidies from supervisor or colleges. The college cultivating international students is responsible for the application and implementation methods.
L319: 
L320: 〖签证〗
L321: 
L322: [Visa]
L323: 
L324: 请于入境前持护照 (有效期四年以上)、录取通知书、外国留学人员来华签证申请表（JW201/202/DQ表）等文件前往中国大使馆（领事馆）申请X1/X2 签证来华。申办材料和流程以当地中国大使馆（领事馆）规定为准，中国大使馆（领事馆）做出的签发、拒签的相关决定为最终决定。
L325: Prior to entry, please apply for an X1/X2 visa for entry into China at the Chinese Embassy (Consulate-General) with your passport (valid for more than four years), admission notice, Visa Application Form for Foreign Students Studying in China (Form JW201/202/DQ), and other relevant documents. The application materials and procedures shall be subject to the requirements of the local Chinese Embassy (Consulate-General).
L326: The decisions on visa issuance or refusal made by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate-General) shall be final.
L327: 〖医疗保险〗
L328: 
L329: [Medical Insurance]
L330: 
L331: 外国留学生必需购买我校指定的来华留学综合保险。保费参考标准为800元人民币/年。对于未按要求购买保险者，我校将不予办理入学注册手续。
L332: 
L333: Foreign students are required to purchase the comprehensive insurance designated by our university for studying in China. The premium reference standard is 800 RMB per year. For those who fail to purchase insurance as required, our school will not handle the enrollment registration procedures.
L334: 
L335: 〖缴费〗
L336: 
L337: [Payment]
L338: 
L339: 收费、退费均以人民币计价。
L340: 
L341: 本科、硕士及语言生第一年全部费用应在收到录取通知书一周内缴清，博士应缴纳保证金2000元，未按时足额交纳费用者不予发送JW202表。
L342: 费用须汇入校方指定账号，不接受外汇。请保存汇款凭证。费用如果不是申请人缴纳，请备注申请人个人信息，以便核查。已经缴纳费用而未到校报到的学生，费用不予退还。
L343: 
L344: Both fees and refunds are priced in Chinese yuan.
L345: 
L346: Undergraduate, master, and language students are required to pay all their first-year fees within one week after receiving the admission notice. Doctoral students are required to pay a deposit of 2000 yuan. Failure to pay tuition fees in full and on time will result in the rejection of the JW202 form.
L347: The fees must be remitted to the designated account of the university, foreign exchange is not accepted. Please save the remittance voucher. If the fee is not paid by the applicant, please note the applicant's personal information for verification. Students who have already paid the fees but have not reported to university will not have their fees refunded.
L348: 
L349: 〖住宿〗
L350: 
L351: [Accommodation]
L352: 
L353: 河南工业大学正式录取的留学生，入住我校留学生公寓。学习期间如有重大疾病，且经校医院或学校指定医疗单位检查，证明的确不宜在校居住的学生可申请外宿。外宿学生可凭借我校来华留学生管理科开具的《校外住宿证明》，提前联系好住所。
L354: 国际学生应于入住后24小时内到所在地派出所办理住宿登记手续。凭有效住宿登记，方可办理签证手续。
L355: The international students officially admitted by Henan University of Technology will stay in our school's international student apartment. If International student has serious illness during the study period and has been diagnosed by the school hospital or designated medical unit as unsuitable for living on campus, they can apply for off-campus accommodation.
L356: International students can contact their accommodation in advance with the "Certificate of Off-campus Accommodation" issued by School of International Education in university.
L357: International students should go to the local police station within 24 hours after check-in to complete the accommodation registration procedures. Visa procedures can only be processed with valid accommodation registration.
